title: Refund Policy | Pixel One Visuals
metaDescription: Refund policy at Pixel One Visuals: when refunds are possible, non-refundable cases, and how to submit a review request.
texts: Pixel One Visuals services are custom digital services delivered on demand. Therefore, refunds are not automatically available once work has started or once any usable output has been delivered. However, we apply a fair refund process in the exceptional cases listed below.
Duplicate charge for the same order (the duplicate amount is refunded in full).
Order cancelled by us before actual execution begins.
Complete inability to deliver the service due to a confirmed internal failure with no deliverable provided.
Project not started within an agreed timeline without a documented operational reason.

If part of the scope has already been completed before a cancellation request, a partial refund may be approved after deducting the value of completed work and related operational costs. This is assessed based on project logs, communications, and delivered outputs up to the request date.
Change of mind or direction after execution has been approved.
Delivery of a draft or initial version that matches the agreed scope.
Rejection based on personal taste while written requirements were respected.
Delays caused by the client's failure to provide materials or responses on time.
Requests for new modifications outside the original scope (treated as an additional request).
Client use of any part of delivered files in publication or production.
The request must be submitted within 7 calendar days from the date of the disputed event.
The request must include: order number, refund reason, and any supporting evidence.
Requests are reviewed within 3 to 7 business days.
We may request additional information before issuing a final decision.

When approved, the refund is issued through the original payment method whenever possible. The time for funds to appear in the client account may vary depending on the payment provider or bank. Third-party fees (if any) may be deducted according to the provider policy.

Before opening a payment dispute (chargeback), you must contact us first to attempt an amicable resolution. If a direct dispute is opened despite evidence of service execution or deliverables, we reserve the right to submit a full rebuttal file to the payment provider.

In force majeure events or large technical outages beyond reasonable control, timelines may be extended without creating an automatic right to refund, while the client is informed with available operational updates.

This policy is subject to applicable laws in the Kingdom of Morocco unless otherwise agreed in writing. This policy may be updated when service models or compliance requirements change, and the "Last updated" date is the official reference for the active version.
